root_idea.summary: The direct semantic center of كَيْف is inquiry into a describable state, quality, or manner—“how?”. The same root record also contains the distinct noun الكِيفَة, “a piece of cloth.”
root_idea.development: The evidence juxtaposes the cloth noun with the interrogative كيف without establishing a secure derivational path between them. In Quranic usage, inquiry into state or manner also functions rhetorically to alert or rebuke the addressee.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The three QAC occurrences tagged N are the same lexical كيف interrogative as the larger INTG group; the tag difference does not require a separate public headword.

senses.definition: How?—asking about the state, quality, or manner of a person, thing, or event.
senses.usage_conditions: The question concerns a describable condition or mode of occurrence, whether the answer is explicit or understood. Quranic rhetorical references to divine matters are treated under the following usage.

senses.definition: How could, can, or will it be?—a rhetorical question used to draw attention to a matter or to rebuke the addressee.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic rhetoric, especially in statements concerning divine acts or the conduct of people, كيف may alert or reproach rather than seek an ordinary informational answer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece or cut section of cloth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct nominal lexical item recorded separately from the interrogative كيف.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To specify something by ascribing a quality to it; to make it defined by a particular quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II usage in theological terminology; the formation is reported as analogical rather than as a form heard from the Arabs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become specified by, or acquire, a particular quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V usage in the same theological terminology; the formation is reported as analogical rather than as a form heard from the Arabs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Quality as answering the question “how?”; the mode or manner of being.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun referring to the quality, mode, or manner in which something exists or occurs.

lane_unit_coverage.note: States the Form II causative and Form V inchoative theological uses.
Pointer-only reference with no independent definition.
Defines كيفية as quality, mode, or manner of being.

cautions: QAC separates three occurrences under a nominal tag and eighty under INTG; they are presented together because the evidence supports one lexical interrogative كيف with the same Quranic uses.
